Data.purpose: Permettre une configuration automatique avec forçage manuel explicite sans transformer tous les champs en structures complexes.
use_when: a value has a meaningful automatic source or calculation
a project or editor may intentionally force a different value
the reason for a manual override may need to be audited
do_not_use_when: the value is a simple canonical fact
the value has no automatic derivation
an ordinary project configuration layer is sufficient
Data.effective_value_rule: The effective value is derived at runtime/build time and is not stored back into the canonical source unless it becomes an explicit source value.
rules: Manual override never mutates the automatic source.
Automatic output and explicit override are distinguishable in Dev diagnostics.
A forced value must remain removable so the configuration can return to automatic resolution.
Technical comments are optional annotations and must not duplicate canonical facts already present elsewhere.

dictionnaire_donnees.note: Convention générique de résolution automatique/manuelle; les valeurs simples restent simples.
